fullPassage: Those who migrate out of poor countries today need to have the money to afford the cost of travel and have the grit (or the advanced degrees) required to overcome a system of immigration control typically loaded against them. For this reason, a lot of them bring exceptional talents — skills, ambition, patience, and stamina — that help them become job creators, or raise children who will be job creators. A report by the Center for American Entrepreneurship found that, in 2017, out of the largest five hundred US companies by revenue, 43 percent were founded or co-founded by immigrants or the children of immigrants. Moreover, immigrant-founded firms account for 52 percent of the top twenty-five firms, 57 percent of the top thirty-five firms, and nine of the top thirteen most valuable brands. Henry Ford was the son of an Irish immigrant. Steve Jobs's biological father was from Syria. Sergey Brin was born in Russia.

det.tip: immigrant=이민자. 영구 정착(live permanently)이 핵심

questions.passage: A report by the Center for American Entrepreneurship found that, in 2017, out of the largest five hundred US companies by revenue, 43 percent were founded or co-founded by immigrants or the children of immigrants. Moreover, immigrant-founded firms account for 52 percent of the top twenty-five firms, 57 percent of the top thirty-five firms, and nine of the top thirteen most __________ (value) brands.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: value(명사/동사) → valuable(형용사): 명사 brands를 수식하는 형용사 필요
det.analysis: value(가치) → valuable(가치 있는). 'most __________ brands'에서 최상급 most 뒤, 명사 brands 앞이므로 형용사가 와야 함. 명사 value에 -able을 붙여 형용사 valuable로 변환
det.tip: value + -able = valuable(가치 있는). most valuable=가장 가치 있는

questions.passage: Those who migrate out of poor countries today need to have the money to afford the cost of travel and have the grit (or the advanced degrees) __________ (require) to overcome a system of immigration control typically loaded against them. For this reason, a lot of them bring exceptional talents that help them become job creators.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: require(동사) → required(과거분사): 앞 명사 grit/degrees를 수식하는 과거분사
det.analysis: require(요구하다) → required(요구되는). 'the grit ... __________ to overcome'에서 명사(grit/degrees)를 뒤에서 수식하는 분사가 필요. 투지가 '요구되는' 것이므로 수동 의미의 과거분사 required 사용 (= which is required)
det.tip: 명사 뒤 수식 과거분사(reduced relative): the grit (which is) required=요구되는 투지

questions.passage: Those who migrate out of poor countries today need to have the money to afford the cost of travel and have the grit (or the advanced degrees) required to overcome a system of immigration control typically __________. For this reason, a lot of them bring exceptional talents — skills, ambition, patience, and stamina — that help them become job creators, or raise children who will be job creators. A report by the Center for American Entrepreneurship found that, in 2017, out of the largest five hundred US companies by revenue, 43 percent were founded or co-founded by immigrants or the children of immigrants. Moreover, immigrant-founded firms account for 52 percent of the top twenty-five firms, 57 percent of the top thirty-five firms, and nine of the top thirteen most valuable brands. Henry Ford was the son of an Irish immigrant. Steve Jobs's biological father was from Syria. Sergey Brin was born in Russia.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 그들에게 ______(불리하게 짜인) 이민 통제 시스템
det.analysis:
❌ ① open to everyone(누구에게나 열린): 극복해야 할 시스템이므로 모순
✅ ② loaded against them(그들에게 불리하게 짜인): 이민자가 '극복해야' 하는 시스템 ← 정답
❌ ③ designed for tourists(관광객을 위한): 이민 통제와 무관
❌ ④ free of charge(무료의): 문맥 무관
det.tip: loaded against ~=~에게 불리하게 짜인. overcome(극복하다)이 단서

questions.passage: Those who migrate out of poor countries today need to have the money to afford the cost of travel and have the grit (or the advanced degrees) required to overcome a system of __________ typically loaded against them. For this reason, a lot of them bring exceptional talents — skills, ambition, patience, and stamina — that help them become job creators, or raise children who will be job creators. A report by the Center for American Entrepreneurship found that, in 2017, out of the largest five hundred US companies by revenue, 43 percent were founded or co-founded by immigrants or the children of immigrants. Moreover, immigrant-founded firms account for 52 percent of the top twenty-five firms, 57 percent of the top thirty-five firms, and nine of the top thirteen most valuable brands. Henry Ford was the son of an Irish immigrant. Steve Jobs's biological father was from Syria. Sergey Brin was born in Russia.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 그들에게 불리하게 짜인 ______(이민 통제) 시스템을 극복해야 한다
det.analysis:
✅ ① immigration control(이민 통제): 가난한 나라를 떠나는 이민자가 극복해야 할 시스템 ← 정답
❌ ② financial support(재정 지원): 극복 대상이 될 수 없음
❌ ③ social welfare(사회 복지): 문맥 무관
❌ ④ public education(공교육): 문맥 무관
det.tip: a system of immigration control=이민 통제 시스템. migrate/overcome이 단서
